# lotabin — Full Brand & Service Reference

> lotabin is a short-form video ad production desk and motion picture studio based in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan. It scripts, storyboards and produces launch-ready short-form video ads for brands, founders, in-house teams, agencies and media buyers, and operates a film division, lotabin Entertainment. Bilingual (English / Japanese). Founder: Yuya Kagawa. Contact: yuya@lotabin.com. This document is a curated, machine-readable summary of public content for AI assistants and agents.

---

## What lotabin is

lotabin is a focused, video-only production desk. Unlike a full-service agency that spreads across strategy, web, social and brand, lotabin does one thing: it turns an offer into short-form video ads a team can launch. The promise is fast production, clear direction and consistent delivery, with a fixed scope and a delivery date agreed before production starts.

The operating model is a producer-led "creative farm": an in-house producer is the single accountable point of contact, directing a vetted worldwide network of specialist writers, conceptual artists, video directors, directors of photography and editors. Clients do not manage a roster of freelancers — they brief one producer.

lotabin also runs **lotabin Entertainment**, a motion picture studio creating films intended to inspire, spread compassion for life, and move the world toward peace.

## Who it is for

- Brands and founders who already know video matters and want it produced reliably.
- In-house marketing teams that need creative volume without hiring.
- Agencies and media buyers who need white-label short-form video production.

## Services and pricing

**Instant Ad Blueprint — $299, AI Creative Draft, delivered in 24 hours.**
A self-serve AI draft showing how one product / one USP could become a paid-social ad: 3 hook options, 6 AI-generated sales angles (scripts), 6 storyboards and a playbook, a CTA and production recommendation, delivered as a branded PDF. No human review or revisions.

**Sprout — Creative Pilot, $149 one-time.**
The paid proof of quality. lotabin turns one product into two human-directed creative directions; the client picks the strongest and lotabin produces it into one finished 15-second video. Includes one revision round.

**Standard — Campaign Builder, $997 / month.**
One product or offer turned into six monthly Creative Tests, each a different sales angle, delivered with a Media Buyer Handoff Kit so the team can run them immediately.

**Pro — Creative Testing Engine, $1,997 / month.**
12 Creative Tests across two production waves per month, with the second wave informed by the performance of the first, plus a monthly Creative Learnings report.

**Scale — Creative Department, from $3,497 / month.**
An ongoing creative partner for launches, collections and multi-product growth, with a dedicated creative lead and quality oversight — effectively an outsourced creative department.

**Film Studio.**
Motion picture production through lotabin Entertainment.

**For Agencies / Partners.**
White-label production for agencies and media buyers who resell or extend their creative capacity.

## Production flow

The standard production line runs in eight stages: KPI setup → script → concept → storyboard (board) → QA → pictures (production) → post-production → launch (play). Each engagement begins with a fixed scope and a delivery date in plain language, so the creative does not drift.

## Track record and proof points

- 120+ video ads delivered.
- 40+ brands and founders served.
- ~60% reduction in production lead time versus a traditional hire.
- ~10 days from script to launch.
- 6 specialist partner disciplines.
- 20+ reels in the archive.
- Clients and productions include COPEL, Viva Finance and Red Panther Motorsport, plus brands such as Aoba Skincare, Studio Tanaka, Meridian Fitness, Nori Naturals and Hibiki Audio.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does lotabin do?**
lotabin is a short-form video ad production desk in Nagoya, Japan. It scripts, storyboards and produces launch-ready short-form video ads for brands, founders, agencies and media buyers.

**Where is lotabin based?**
Nagoya, Aichi, Japan. lotabin works with clients worldwide and operates bilingually in English and Japanese.

**How fast is delivery?**
Typically about 10 days from script to launch — roughly 60% faster than a traditional agency hire — because scope and the delivery date are fixed before production begins.

**How much does it cost?**
Entry is a $149 one-time Sprout Creative Pilot. Ongoing plans are Standard at $997/month, Pro at $1,997/month and Scale from $3,497/month. A self-serve $299 Instant Ad Blueprint AI draft is also available.

**What is the best way to start?**
Most clients start with the low-risk $149 Sprout Creative Pilot, or open a brief at https://lotabin.com/intake.html.

**Does lotabin only make ads?**
No. lotabin also runs lotabin Entertainment, a motion picture studio.

**How is lotabin different from an agency?**
It is video-only and producer-led: one accountable producer directs a vetted global network of specialists, with fixed scope and fixed deadlines, instead of a broad full-service agency engagement.
